personality_one_liner: A highly gamified, vibrant, and energetic family companion that turns chores into rewarding quests.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Chunky layout avoiding density.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use as a backdrop for the FAB.
dont's: Do not use on task cards, reward cards, or standard list items.
Avoid on heavy UI elements to maintain the tactile, chunky feel.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Empathetic, welcoming login and registration flow for parents to set up the family.

states.error: Card with red warning text and 'Réessayer' button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed playful background, large welcoming typography, and chunky primary buttons. PIN entry modal utilizes oversized numeric keypad.

screens.name: Kid_Accueil
screens.purpose: The kid's central hub displaying current streak, points, avatar, and today's main quest.

states.loading: Skeleton of the streak banner and today's task card.
states.empty: Illustration of the mascot sleeping with text 'Aucune quête aujourd'hui!'

screens.layout: Personalized greeting at top. Progress/streak bar prominent. A unified, path-like display for today's tasks to focus attention.

screens.name: Kid_Taches
screens.purpose: List of recurring and one-off tasks with the ability to upload photo proof.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean room, 'Tout est fait!'.

screens.layout: List of chunky chore cards. Each card displays reward points clearly. Task detail uses a bottom sheet to prompt camera upload.

screens.name: Kid_Classement
screens.purpose: Weekly leaderboard showing family members' rankings.
screens.layout: Top half is a multi-tiered podium (1st, 2nd, 3rd) with avatars. Bottom half is a list view of all participants showing their proximity to the next rank.

screens.name: Kid_Boutique
screens.purpose: Reward shop where kids can spend earned points on rewards.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty chest, 'La boutique est vide pour le moment!'.

screens.layout: Sticky wallet balance at the top. 2-column grid of reward cards with transparent point costs and large 'Réclamer' pill buttons.

screens.name: Parent_Dashboard
screens.purpose: Parent's overview of family progress, pending validations, and quick actions.

states.empty: Illustration of parents relaxing, 'Rien à valider!'.

screens.layout: Data-rich but clean management view. Top section shows pending approvals, followed by top performer highlights and quick links to manage chores.

screens.name: Validation_Feed
screens.purpose: A feed for parents and family members to approve or reject photo proofs of completed tasks.

states.empty: Illustration of a checkmark shield, 'Toutes les preuves sont validées!'.

screens.layout: Vertical scrolling feed of photo proofs. Each post features large 'Approuver' (green) and 'Rejeter' (red/orange) floating pill buttons.

screens.name: Shared_Calendar
screens.purpose: Shared family calendar with month and agenda views.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty calendar page.

screens.layout: Month view on top with colored dots for events, agenda list view below scrolling independently.

screens.name: Shared_Shopping_List
screens.purpose: Shared checklist for family groceries and needs.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty basket, 'Le frigo est plein!'.

screens.layout: Simple list of chunky rows with oversized custom checkboxes. Floating action button (FAB) to add new items.

hero_kid_dashboard.alt: Playful mascot representing the app guide

empty_validations.alt: Checklist on paper indicating all done

parent_welcome.alt: Parent and child high five at sunset

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Language: Apply 'Tactile/Playful' heavily. Use chunky cards, large hit areas (44x44pt min), and soft, rounded typography (Fredoka/Nunito).
Avoid Blues: Strictly adhere to the color palette provided (Greens, Oranges, Yellows). Do not use default iOS blue, system indigo, or any shade of purple.
Language: Ensure EVERY label, button, empty state, error message, and placeholder is in French as requested.
Gamification UX: The kid's view must feel like a game. Emphasize streaks (flame icon), points (XP pill), and progress bars.
Navigation: Implement a separate bottom_tabs navigation for Kid (Accueil, Tâches, Classement, Boutique) and Parent (Dashboard, Valider, Calendrier, Paramètres).
Interaction: Add overshoot spring animations on buttons and implement the defined haptics for task completion.
Photo Validation: Design the validation feed akin to a social feed with large, accessible approve/reject buttons.
Adhere to the exact layout rules extracted from the research: modular task cards, prominent visual progress trackers, and multi-tiered podium for the leaderboard.
